scope: Port only selected-workspace startup and synchronous Auth epoch fences to current main. Full original pipeline read, UI, server/Auth/database contracts remain; no Phase3–15 pagination/projection/Settings experiment.
acceptance: Full relevant functional/security/draft tests, source drift checks and all planned outcomes must pass.
Cold selected reads must start alongside module loading and show meaningful navigation improvement; warm fresh-validation cost is reported as the required security tradeoff.
No material unexplained tail regression beyond that explicit fresh-validation contract. Do not replace slow rows; failed host profiles are excluded whole with evidence.
controls: Frozen source/build/fixture/plan/collectors, BA then AB per profile; host and actual sleep audit; no builds/tests during collection; no synthetic loading/application readiness changes.
security: Remote identity + live session/revocation/account/membership/capabilities/suspension/support/anonymous/voting remain unchanged. Private no-store/Cookie transport and Demo isolation preserved. Client epochs never authorize reads. New visits must validate before content is visible.
publication: User authorizes ready changes on main after validation. Keep rejected/unresolved app changes separate; no production configuration/DB/schema/index/region changes.
